title: School communication
scenario: You are in a teacher role. Use English naturally in this school communication situation.

lines.text: I'd like to discuss the feedback from last week's parent meeting.
Yes, several parents raised concerns about homework volume.
I understand. We should adjust our policy accordingly.
I have drafted a new homework schedule for your review.
Thank you. I will review it and reply by Wednesday.
Furthermore, the principal has asked for a formal report.
I will prepare the report and submit it by Friday.
If we address the concerns early, we can avoid bigger issues.

ai_conversation.scenario: Ask about student progress at parent-teacher meeting.
ai_conversation.opening_line: Hello, teacher. I wanted to ask about my child's progress.
